parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans presentation, no state-run universal facility rule, and no documented police campaign — but the operative exposures are serious. An official report documents routine refusal of medical care, including general treatment, plus service denial with no statutory protection and no legal recognition. Civilian anti-LGBTQ violence is described as commonplace, perpetrators go unpursued, and victims conceal identity from police out of fear of mistreatment — societal hostility with effectively no recourse (tier 3, violence severity elevated though frequency is unquantified). Religious institutions add documented demonisation and conversion practice, with an urban/rural hostility split. Thin paper protections (data rules, an electronic incitement offence) are unshown in operation; UPR acceptance of two recommendations is aspirational. Border document treatment is unsourced — an open question, not an exposure. Absence of criminalisation does not anchor this above the elevated band given documented care denial and impunity.
